meta.title: Tavern reply layout
meta.description: Renders tavern-preset replies as layered prose, status cards, feeds, chats and choices instead of one flat block of text.

settings.title: Tavern reply layout
settings.enabledHint: Turn off to fall back to the plain Markdown rendering. Changes apply to every session in this profile.
settings.streamingGuard: Wait for the reply to finish
settings.streamingGuardHint: Hold rendering while a reply is still streaming, so the layout does not flicker mid-sentence.
settings.minSpeechHint: Only restyle a reply when it has at least this many quoted lines. Raises the bar for ordinary chat.
